review.rationale: The patch lane C comprehensively documents the R1-R6 remediation and validation chain for TITMAS CE-G11B. All artifacts (Recommendations, Decision Records, Qwen Reviews, Results, Reports, and Errata) are internally consistent, preserve prior failures without retroactive alteration, strictly enforce caps (zero network fallbacks, zero retries, zero merges, zero remote mutations, zero truth surface mutations), and correctly distinguish local static validation from release/deployment authority. The R6 formal release context is explicitly bounded to a local static export and verification command within a disposable frozen merge-tree worktree, prohibiting tag/release/deployment/server actions. All required results, frozen inputs, and execution contracts align across the chain. No causal breaks, unauthorized retries, cap violations, or unsupported PASS claims were found.
